page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head above it and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: dum non est, sed ad ordinaria
rimos, à paucissimis. Adeo ut si
Et certè si multis licet ad-

page.notes: The page number's last digit is printed in the old yogh-like form of 3, so it is given as 9ȝ[?]. The first word "fis" is a fragment of a word cut off at the page's left edge, kept as printed. Small specks and stains around the text (near "exitum", at the right margin and below the text) are not printed text and are left out. The "Præ-" catchword is the only word at the foot of the page.
